text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: This is a review article explicitly focused on land-use change (LUC) in the context of bioenergy policies. It synthesizes existing knowledge on how bioenergy production affects land-use change, discusses modelling approaches and data relevant to LUC, including indirect land-use change (iLUC), and evaluates the capacity of current land-use models and data to inform policy. The paper addresses both local and global scales, considers future scenarios, and emphasizes the need for integrated assessment of land-use dynamics related to bioenergy. It does not present original spatially explicit LULC predictions but provides a comprehensive review of LULC future prediction tools and their policy relevance.)
